findings.description: The per-chunk debug log prints `chunks[0].score` for every rank instead of the score of the chunk being logged (`chunk.score`).
findings.rationale: Whenever retrieval returns two or more chunks, each log line for rank 2 and beyond reports the top chunk's score, so the logged scores do not match the chunks they label. The impact is misleading debug output when diagnosing retrieval or abstention behavior; no runtime control flow is affected.
